project_name: MahaFlow - Live Crowd Intelligence & Transit Management Platform

branding.motto: Real-time Crowd Analytics, CCTV Surveillance & Transport Operations for Maharashtra Transit
branding.style: Command Center Tactical Glass & High-Density Radar Aesthetics

grids.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete responsive layouts for Passenger, Authority, and Developer role portals.
Implement real Google Auth + Email/Password onboarding wizard for Authority role.
Post-auth verification step must accept access codes (e.g. MS-PUNE-BUS-01, CR-MUM-RLY-02) and automatically resolve state, facility type (Bus Stand vs Railway Station), and locked facility location.
Allow adding multiple real CCTV camera streams with active status, RTSP/HLS stream URLs, and camera name inputs.

Implement Settings section for Passenger (Profile, Saved Routes, Notifications), Authority (Basic System Config, Operating Hours, Staff Alerts), and Developer (Advanced API Keys, YOLO26n AI Worker Connection, Database RLS Debugger, System Logs).
Transport Registry in Authority portal must allow adding/editing real Bus and Train schedules, vehicle numbers, driver IDs, and occupancy statuses.
Prepare architecture for YOLO26n AI Worker model integration: display live FPS, detection bounding box overlays on CCTV feeds, model latency metrics, and real vs predicted crowd status badges.
Integrate real Google Maps JS API container or iframe embedded view with live crowd heatmaps and station markers.
All interactive elements must include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="authority-login-google-btn", data-testid="cctv-add-stream-button").

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Always maintain high contrast against dark backgrounds (#0B0F17 / #111827). Ensure no dark grey text on dark backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_states: Hover states must explicitly set text colors, e.g. hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: Mandatory on all buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and interactive elements using kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_placeholders: Do not render 'Under Construction' or empty boxes. Populate all data grids, CCTV panels, transport tables, and maps with rich, actionable UI components.
